evidence.title: Learnify | Web Development Tutorials, Quizzes & Roadmaps

name: Learnify
summary: Beginner-friendly web development tutorials with quizzes and step-by-step learning roadmaps.
description: Tutorial platform for learning web development: bite-sized, jargon-free lessons on HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Python, plus interactive quizzes and step-by-step roadmaps (with visual roadmap views) that say what to learn and in what order. Built and maintained by Shefali for self-taught developers.
contains: tutorials on HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Python
learning roadmaps for CSS, JavaScript, Python, React and HTML, each with a visual roadmap view
